metadata.description: Ask the owner decisions on their phone from Claude Code, and get the answers back in the session that asked.

plugins.name: starbridge
plugins.description: The starbridge skill, and a SessionStart rule that has every session reach the owner through it. Needs the starbridge CLI on PATH, paired.

plugins.name: starbridge-mod
plugins.description: Submits each answer into the session that asked, through the machine's starbridge agent, or the CLI when no agent runs. A Claude Code mod: install it beside the starbridge plugin; a build that cannot load mods skips it.
